newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria passes on 100,000 T durum tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria passes on 100,000 T durum tender - traders.

text.p: Algeria passed up offers in its import tender for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Canadian durum wheat because prices offered were too high, European grain traders said on Friday.
There was, however, no official confirmation that Algeria had passed on the tender.
Traders did not know if Algeria planned to place another tender for the wheat soon.
Algeria was seeking to import 50,000 tonnes of durum wheat for shipment in the first half of December and another 50,000 tonnes for shipment in the second half of December.
